structure: Part 4, Consignment parties. Read in full: e2e/consignment-parties.fit.spec.js (455 lines, 14 tests in 5 describes), e2e/support/journey.js (283 lines: the URL helpers, action buttons, error summary and back-link assertions, the toRoles set-up steps, CORE_ADDRESSES, chooseAddress and fillCph) and e2e/support/fixtures.js (48 lines: records the pages each test visits; asserts nothing). Describes: 'consignment addresses' (8 tests: the cattle roles page, the cat roles page, picking an address for every role plus the CPH number page, remove, the same-as shortcuts, the picker search, a picker continued empty, save and return to hub), 'add an address from the journey' (2 tests: place of origin entered by hand, consignee found by UK postcode), 'add-address pages for the other roles' (1 test over consignor, importer and place of destination), 'permanent address' (2 tests: the per-animal page for cats, the retired enter-address path) and 'contact address for consignment' (1 test: it redirects to the review). Routes covered, all under /design-release-2.1: /roles-and-addresses, /place-of-origin, /consignor-or-exporter, /consignee, /importer, /place-of-destination, /<role>/add-address, /<role>/find-address, /<role>/find-address/select, /cph-number, /permanent-address, /permanent-address/select, /permanent-address/enter-address, /contact-address-for-consignment. Claims run in test order, then shared helper claims, then gaps.

await page.locator('#address-id').selectOption('ch-M11AL-0')
      await submitForm(page, 'Continue')
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/consignee/add-address'))
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(/foundAddressId=ch-M11AL-0/)

claims.statement: The found address fills the add-address form: address line 1 'FLAT 105 OXID HOUSE', address line 2 '78 NEWTON STREET', town 'MANCHESTER' and postcode 'M1 1AL'.
claims.quote:
await expect(page.getByLabel('Address line 1', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('FLAT 105 OXID HOUSE')
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Address line 2 (optional)', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('78 NEWTON STREET')
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Town or city', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('MANCHESTER')
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Postcode', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('M1 1AL')

claims.statement: On the add-address form filled from a UK postcode search, the postcode field is labelled 'Postcode', not 'Postcode or Zip code' as on the hand-entered form.
claims.quote: await expect(page.getByLabel('Postcode', { exact: true })).toHaveValue('M1 1AL')
claims.note: Inferred from an exact-label match on 'Postcode' here and on 'Postcode or Zip code' on the origin form. The spec does not say whether the country field is shown or fixed to the UK on this form.

claims.statement: On the consignee add-address form, the other uses offered are 'Importer' and 'Place of destination'.
claims.quote: await expect(page.locator('input[name="addressUses"] + label')).toHaveText(['Importer', 'Place of destination'])

claims.statement: The add-address form reached from a postcode search has its back link to the find address page (/consignee/find-address).
claims.quote: await expectBackLink(page, url('/consignee/find-address'))

claims.statement: An add-address form filled from a postcode search still needs a name and contact details: 'Save and select' with them blank shows 'Enter a name or organisation name', 'Enter an email address' and 'Enter a phone number'.
claims.quote:
await clickAction(page, 'select')
      await expectErrorSummary(page, ['Enter a name or organisation name', 'Enter an email address', 'Enter a phone number'])

claims.statement: 'Save and select' on a complete add-address form saves the address, selects it for the role and returns the user to /roles-and-addresses, where its name shows.
claims.quote:
await test.step('save and select records it and returns to the roles page', async () => {
      ...
      await clickAction(page, 'select')
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/roles-and-addresses'))
      await expectNoErrorSummary(page)
      await expect(main).toContainText('Oxid House Imports')
claims.note: That it is selected for the consignee role is inferred from the name showing on the roles page; the spec does not check which section.

claims.statement: The consignor's 'Add a new address' link opens /consignor-or-exporter/add-address directly, a hand-entered form headed 'Add an address for a consignor', with its back link to /consignor-or-exporter.
claims.quote: ['consignor-or-exporter', 'Add an address for a consignor', 'Consignor', ['Place of origin']],

claims.statement: The consignor add-address form says 'This address will be added to your address book as a Consignor. Select any other types of address this can also be used for.' and offers 'Place of origin' as the only other use.
claims.quote:
await expect(page.locator('main')).toContainText(new RegExp(`This address will be added to your address book as an? ${role}\\. Select any other types of address this can also be used for\\.`))
      await expect(page.locator('input[name="addressUses"] + label')).toHaveText(otherUses)

claims.statement: The importer's 'Add a new address' link opens /importer/find-address, headed 'Add an address for an importer', with the 'Enter a UK postcode' field and its back link to /importer; 'Enter address manually' opens /importer/add-address?manual=true under the same heading.
claims.quote: ['importer', 'Add an address for an importer', 'Importer', ['Consignee', 'Place of destination']],

claims.statement: The importer add-address form says the address will be added 'as an Importer' and offers 'Consignee' and 'Place of destination' as other uses.
claims.quote: ['importer', 'Add an address for an importer', 'Importer', ['Consignee', 'Place of destination']],
claims.note: The regex 'as an? ${role}' allows 'a' or 'an'; 'an Importer' is inferred from English grammar.

claims.statement: The place of destination's 'Add a new address' link opens /place-of-destination/find-address, headed 'Add an address for a place of destination', with the 'Enter a UK postcode' field and its back link to /place-of-destination; 'Enter address manually' opens /place-of-destination/add-address?manual=true under the same heading.
claims.quote: ['place-of-destination', 'Add an address for a place of destination', 'Place of destination', ['Consignee', 'Importer']]

claims.statement: The place of destination add-address form says the address will be added 'as a Place of destination' and offers 'Consignee' and 'Importer' as other uses.
claims.quote: ['place-of-destination', 'Add an address for a place of destination', 'Place of destination', ['Consignee', 'Importer']]

claims.statement: The 'Add a permanent address' link leads to /permanent-address/select, the per-animal permanent address page.
claims.quote:
await page.locator('main').getByRole('link', { name: 'Add a permanent address' }).click()
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/permanent-address/select'))
claims.note: The link's href is /permanent-address (p4-023), so /permanent-address redirects to /permanent-address/select; the redirect is inferred.

claims.statement: The permanent address page has the browser title 'Permanent address - Import notification service - GOV.UK' and the heading 'Permanent address'.
claims.quote:
await expect(page).toHaveTitle('Permanent address - Import notification service - GOV.UK')
      await expectHeading(page, 'Permanent address')

claims.statement: The permanent address page warns 'Providing a false address is an act of fraud'.
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('Providing a false address is an act of fraud')

claims.statement: The permanent address page asks 'Where will their permanent address be?'
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('Where will their permanent address be?')

claims.statement: The permanent address page has one card per animal, headed with the species' common and Latin names and the animal's number, such as 'Domestic cat (Felis catus) 1' and 'Domestic cat (Felis catus) 2' for a consignment of two cats.
claims.quote: await expect(main.locator('.app-permanent-address-animal-card__heading')).toHaveText(['Domestic cat (Felis catus) 1', 'Domestic cat (Felis catus) 2'])

claims.statement: Each animal card asks 'Select an address' with two radio options, 'Same as the place of destination (POD)' (value same-as-pod) and 'Enter a new address' (value new-address), named permanentAddressChoice[<species id>:<index>].
claims.quote:
await expect(main.locator('.app-permanent-address-animal-card__legend').first()).toHaveText('Select an address')
      await expect(page.locator('input[name="permanentAddressChoice[cat-felis-catus:0]"] + label')).toHaveText([
        'Same as the place of destination (POD)', 'Enter a new address'
      ])

claims.statement: The permanent address page says 'This is where they will stay after spending 48 hours at the place of destination.'
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('This is where they will stay after spending 48 hours at the place of destination.')

claims.statement: The permanent address page has 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to hub' buttons and a back link to /roles-and-addresses.
claims.quote:
await expect(page.locator('button[name="action"]')).toHaveText(['Save and continue', 'Save and return to hub'])
      await expectBackLink(page, url('/roles-and-addresses'))

claims.statement: Choosing 'Same as the place of destination (POD)' before a place of destination is chosen shows the error 'Add a place of destination before you can continue'.
claims.quote:
await page.locator('input[name="permanentAddressChoice[cat-felis-catus:0]"][value="same-as-pod"]').check()
      await saveAndContinue(page)
      await expectErrorSummary(page, ['Add a place of destination before you can continue'])

claims.statement: Choosing 'Enter a new address' for an animal reveals an address form inside that animal's card (fields such as permanentAddressDetails-<species id>-<index>-name).
claims.quote:
await page.locator('input[name="permanentAddressChoice[cat-felis-catus:0]"][value="new-address"]').check()
      await expect(page.locator('#permanentAddressDetails-cat-felis-catus-0-name')).toBeVisible()

    await toRoles(page, SPECIES.cat, 1)
    await page.goto(url('/permanent-address/enter-address'))

claims.statement: Journey pages with the action button group submit a button named 'action' whose value says what happens: continue (Save and continue), hub (Save and return to hub), select and return on add-address, and remove-address:<role> on the roles page.
claims.quote:
const saveAndContinue = (page) => clickAction(page, 'continue')
const saveAndReturnToOverview = (page) => clickAction(page, 'hub')
claims.note: mechanism: one form field, action, carries the chosen button.
